title: Spark connection / Dive into Instagram Reels

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Pair a product invitation with a personal moment so the service feels connected to human expression.
strategic_value: The informal portrait and Reels invitation can give Instagram a people-centered voice.
demonstration: A portrait fills the vertical composition, with Dive into Instagram Reels broken across its open areas and interface symbols at right.
practical_value: Place an invitation around the person’s face while retaining recognizable product cues.

content_islands.name: Portrait
content_islands.spec: Fill the frame with the expressive close-up and raised hand.

content_islands.name: Invitation and interface cues
content_islands.spec: Distribute white words through open areas and align social symbols down the right edge.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying Spark connection principle says Instagram products bring people together.
reference_purposes.Expression: The loose wording and portrait give the invitation an informal character.
reference_purposes.Application: The composition applies the system to a Reels promotion.
